name: charlykit-municipal-tools
purpose: Reusable municipal RAG, source, truth and action tools for agents.

tools.name: import_source
tools.description: Import a public municipal source URL or pasted text and propose reviewed knowledge chunks.

tools.name: search_sources
tools.description: Search approved municipal knowledge chunks for a citizen question.

tools.name: classify_statement
tools.description: Classify a statement as factual claim, value/norm, belief, prediction, preference or ambiguity.

tools.name: create_action_payload
tools.description: Create a draft appointment, callback or ticket payload from an intent and context.

tools.name: create_receipt
tools.description: Create a human-readable and machine-readable receipt for a response or workflow step.

tools.name: run_eval
tools.description: Run a small evaluation set against the current knowledge base and routing rules.
